name: EJRP Summer Full Day Camps
description_short: Weekday full-day camps (7:30 am to 5:30 pm) run by Essex Junction Recreation & Parks for children entering grades 1 to 8: Camp Maple Street, Camp Discovery, Camp REACH and Camp Nova, based at Maple Street Park and local schools, with swim lessons, sports, art and Friday field trips.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel in writing to reckids@ejrp.org at least three weeks before the week starts for a refund minus an administrative fee (5% before May 1, 10% after). With less notice, a refund is given only if the week is full, there is a waitlist and another family takes the spot; fees then run 15% to 25%.
swim_waterfront_notes: Every Camp Maple Street camper gets swim lessons at Maple Street Pool and two hours of free swim; Camp Discovery campers get swim lessons at Sandhill Pool.

sources.note: Grades are the grade entering in fall. $245/week is for Camp Maple Street, Discovery and REACH; Camp Nova is $200/week; short weeks A ($147/$120) and B ($196/$160). Session prices left blank because they differ by camp.

source.title: Summer Full Day Camps - Essex Junction Recreation & Parks

warnings: The 2026 season is over and no 2027 details have been posted yet. The page says: "Check back in January for details on Summer 2027 registration."
The page has almost no detail. It names four camps (Camp Maple Street, Camp Discovery, Camp REACH, Camp Nova) but gives no ages, dates or prices for any of them.
The 'Hours: 8am-4pm, Monday-Friday' line sits next to the department phone number. It is probably office hours, not camp hours.
The address and phone number belong to the Essex Junction Rec Dept. The camps may meet somewhere else.
unknowns: Age or grade range for each camp (Maple Street, Discovery, REACH, Nova)

Whether meals or snacks are included
